name: Anime BGM cue library
description: Background-music prompts for anime-style scenes. Append to the 'cues' array to add your own; the Anime tab has a Reload button so no restart is needed. Every cue is written for the instrumental adapter (no vocals) and phrased as restrained underscore so it sits under dialogue.

fields.id: unique slug; keep it stable if you want to track a cue across edits
fields.category: must match one of the names in the categories list
fields.title: short label shown on the card
fields.use_when: the scene this is for, in plain language
fields.sound: how it should sound, for your own reference
fields.style: the exact text sent to YuE2
fields.seed: optional fixed seed for a repeatable take
